data.why: Superdry opened its first store in Argentina less than three weeks ago, marking a concrete international retail expansion. Entering a new market directly impacts finance leadership through new local supplier relationships and cross-border payables.
data.angle: Managing new local supplier invoices and AP processing as retail footprint expands into Argentina.

not_chosen.reason: Debt refinancing is a widely covered financing event that every sales rep pitches, making it less distinctive than a specific country launch.
An individual Accounts Payable Assistant job posting is too tactical for an Interim CFO and better suited for an AP manager.
The Tax Manager role focuses strictly on tax compliance and VAT rather than core finance back-office invoice processing.
A general plan for store expansion in Europe is speculative compared to the confirmed store opening in Argentina.
Bad news regarding a founder legal conviction must strictly be avoided in sales outreach.

data.subject: argentina store
data.body:
Hi Greg,

Superdry just opened its first store in Argentina. Entering a new country usually brings a wave of new local suppliers, so who is keying and matching all those invoices in unfamiliar formats today?

Mindbody now has 95% of its invoices processed end to end by Zamp.

Open to seeing how?

[Your name]
